# Science News

> > Science News delivers authoritative journalism covering breakthrough discoveries across biology, physics, medicine, technology, and Earth sciences.

Science News is an independent, nonprofit science journalism organization founded in 1921. The publication features in-depth reporting on cutting-edge research across all scientific disciplines, written by expert science journalists including Tina Hesman Saey, Sujata Gupta, Meghan Rosen, Lisa Grossman, and others.

## Key Topics

- Health & Medicine
- Neuroscience
- Anthropology & Human Evolution
- Microbiology & Infectious Disease
- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- Astronomy & Astrophysics
- Climate Science & Oceanography
- Medical Diagnostics & Oncology
- Conservation Biology
- Genetics & Molecular Biology
- Computer Vision & Deepfake Detection
- Renewable Energy Technologies
- Animal Behavior & Ecology
- Archaeological Discoveries
- Nobel Prize Research

## Health & Medicine

- [Finding immune cells that stop a body from attacking itself wins medicine Nobel](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/immune-cells-medicine-nobel-prize-t-reg): Sakaguchi, Brunkow, Ramsdell win Nobel for T-reg cell autoimmune research
- [mRNA flu vaccines are making their way through clinical trials](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/mrna-flu-vaccines-influenza-virus): mRNA platform offers faster flu vaccine production in clinical trials
- [Some probiotics could feed, rather than fend off, infections](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/probiotics-lactobacillus-infection): Lactobacillus probiotics show mixed results in C. difficile infections in mice
- [It masquerades as malignant. But this bone-covered tumor is benign](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/bone-covered-tumor-mass-is-benign): Novel benign bone tumor characterized to prevent unnecessary chemotherapy

## Neuroscience & Human Biology

- [Brain scans reveal where taste and smell become flavor](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/brain-scans-flavor-insula-taste-smell): Insula region fuses taste and smell into flavor sensation via brain scans
- [Two tiny genetic shifts helped early humans walk upright](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/genetic-shifts-helped-humans-walk-two-legs): Genetic changes in pelvis development linked to bipedalism millions ago
- [Ancient southern Africans took genetic evolution in a new direction](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/ancient-southern-africa-gene-evolution): Human-specific genes changed in isolated population 300,000 years ago

## Artificial Intelligence & Technology

- [AI models spot deepfake images, but people catch fake videos](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/ai-models-deepfakes): Study reveals humans & AI detect different deepfakes, suggesting teamwork
- [This experimental computer chip reuses energy](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/computer-chip-reuses-energy): First-of-its-kind chip demonstrates energy recycling within hardware
- [Lions have a second roar that no one noticed until now](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/lion-new-type-roar-decoded): Machine learning reveals lions have two roar types, aiding conservation

## Climate & Earth Sciences

- [Hundreds of studies have missed how much the oceans are rising](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/studies-missed-sea-level-rise-oceans): Widely used sea level calculation method may have missed century of change
- [Like flyways for birds, we need to map swimways for fish](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/flyways-birds-map-swimways-fish): Ecologists argue for mapping fish migration routes to protect freshwater species
- [Here's how we might generate electricity from rain](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/rain-electricity-energy): Water drops through tubes produce electricity as potential renewable energy

## Astronomy & Physics

- [Black holes are encircled by thin rings of light. This physicist wants to see one](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/alex-lupsasca-black-hole-photon-ring): Alex Lupsasca pushes for space telescope to glimpse black hole photon rings
- [Galaxies with 'hoop skirts' are more common than we thought](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/polar-structure-galaxies-stars-disks): Thousands more polar structure galaxies discovered, aiding evolution studies

## Microbiology & Life Sciences

- [This giant microbe organizes its DNA in a surprising way](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/giant-microbe-bacteria-dna): Thiovulum imperiosus bacterium stores DNA in peripheral pouches, not centrally
- [To make a tasty yogurt, just add ants (and their microbes)](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/yogurt-ants-microbes-fermentation): Researchers identify microbial pals & enzymes in ant-fermented yogurt

## Optional

- [Whaling may have started 1,500 years earlier than already known](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/whaling-brazil-1500-years-earlier): 5,000-year-old whale-bone harpoons suggest Indigenous Brazilian whalers
- [Salt can turn frozen water into a weak power source](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/saltwater-power-source): Strained salty ice generates electricity in experiments, practical uses distant
- [Scientists are people too, a new book reminds readers](https://www.sciencenews.org/article/scientists-shape-of-wonder-researchers): The Shape of Wonder humanizes scientists and demystifies research process
